verdicts.reason: Both share the same broken banner layout: the green circle is split from the can and cropped at the left edge, leaving a meaningless blob, and the can floats alone far right. The SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline, reversing the reading order, and the body copy is illegibly tiny next to a wide empty right-hand area. A wraps that copy into a cramped four-line column with awkward breaks, while B sets it on two lines, which is slightly cleaner; otherwise they are nearly identical.
